# 远行计划局 · 中国出行 Agent Skill v0.3.0

远行计划局 v0.3.0 is an eight-Skill Agent Plugin that combines facts from several providers without hard-coding a city, airport, or personal travel history. This release changes the public brand from 天枢 TravelOS while preserving package, Plugin and Skill IDs.

## Highlights

- Generic gateway ranking compares explicit tax-inclusive flight and ground-access facts, then explains why a gateway wins or remains incomplete.
- Place evidence combines reported opening status, access facts, and optional QWeather outdoor risk without treating any unavailable field as certain.
- `travel-assistant doctor` now reports safe provider-health states for QWeather and Visualize without running paid probes by default.
- Visualize-ready, HTML, SVG, and Markdown itinerary outputs share one `itinerary.json` and show a narrow health ribbon for only the providers used by that trip.
- Desktop credentials move to an optional local configuration page and macOS Keychain; the runtime no longer reads plaintext `credentials.env`.
- The core installer no longer requires optional Node, uvx, FlyAI, Variflight, or Ego components.
- Chinese tier labels 智能选择、从容、拓界、远征 map to the compatible `auto`, `standard`, `pro`, `pro_max` contract values.

## Safety

QWeather uses local Ed25519 JWT signing and a repository-external private key with `0600` permissions. The renderer never shows tokens, private-key paths, raw request URLs, or untrusted remediation text. Booking, payment, changes, cancellation, and refunds still require explicit confirmation.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/19Chris19/china-travel-assistant/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the complete change list.
